messages.text:
The beanie refund is ready to redo, but I can't refund the gloves yet.

**Beanie:** Your earlier request lapsed before it was paid, so a new proposal was needed (refund-policy/v2/validity). I've created one for the Merino wool beanie. The refund is 24.90 BRL, which is what you paid for it (refund-policy/v2/amount). Please confirm it with the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count. A staff member then has to approve it (refund-policy/v2/approval). The proposal is valid for 72 hours (refund-policy/v2/validity).

**Gloves:** A staff member can't grant an exception for this. The shop refunds only units it has received back, and its records don't show the gloves as received (refund-policy/v2/return). Once they arrive, you can request a refund. Your order's refund deadline is 2026-12-02 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window). I haven't proposed anything for the gloves.
